description: This file defines the EntityListIterator class, a Java class implementing a cursor-based iterator over database query results for entities in the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to navigate, retrieve, and manipulate the result set, supporting partial lists, size estimation, and safe resource management.

classes.name: EntityListIterator
classes.description: A cursor-based iterator for traversing database query results in the OFBiz framework, supporting navigation, partial retrieval, and resource management.

methods.name: afterLast
methods.description: Moves cursor to just after the last row.

methods.name: beforeFirst
methods.description: Moves cursor to just before the first row.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Moves cursor to the last row.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Moves cursor to the first row.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the iterator and releases resources.

methods.name: currentGenericValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current row as a GenericValue object.

methods.name: currentIndex
methods.description: Gets the current cursor index.

methods.name: absolute
methods.description: Moves cursor to the specified absolute position.

methods.name: relative
methods.description: Moves cursor relative to current position.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there is a next element.

methods.name: hasPrevious
methods.description: Checks if there is a previous element.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Moves to next row and returns as GenericValue.

methods.name: nextIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the next element.

methods.name: previous
methods.description: Moves to previous row and returns as GenericValue.

methods.name: previousIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the previous element.

methods.name: setFetchSize
methods.description: Sets the fetch size for the ResultSet.

methods.name: getCompleteList
methods.description: Retrieves all remaining results as a list.

methods.name: getPartialList
methods.description: Retrieves a sublist starting at a specific index with a limited size.

methods.name: getResultsSizeAfterPartialList
methods.description: Estimates the total size of the result set.

methods.name: getResultSize
methods.description: Calculates total result size via database count query.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Unsupported method, read-only iterator.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Unsupported method, read-only iterator.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Unsupported method, read-only iterator.

methods.name: closeWithWarning
methods.description: Closes the iterator and logs a warning.

methods.name: tryCloseWithWarning
methods.description: Attempts to close the iterator, logs errors if exceptions occur.
